about.heading: A Higher Standard of Tattooing
about.body: As Above Tattoo is a Salt Lake City tattoo studio built around artistic expression, thoughtful craftsmanship, and a commitment to doing things right. We believe a great tattoo is about more than the finished piece. It's about the entire experience, from the first conversation to the final result. Whether you're bringing a fully realized idea or working with an artist to develop something entirely your own, our goal is to create meaningful, lasting work in a space where you feel comfortable, respected, and confident in your choice.

values.title: Cleanliness
values.description: Your health comes first. We maintain rigorous hygiene standards, use proper sterilization practices, and keep our workspace clean and professional.

values.title: Comfort
values.description: Getting tattooed is a personal experience. We want you to feel welcome, heard, and comfortable throughout the entire process.

values.title: Artistry
values.description: Every tattoo deserves intention and attention to detail. We value individual expression, thoughtful design, and craftsmanship that stands the test of time.

values.title: Quality
values.description: We take pride in the work we put into the world. From the initial design to the finished tattoo, we focus on precision, consistency, and results you'll be proud to wear.
